notes.title: Game Update!
notes.content:
The following changes and improvements are presented in this update:


 Changes made in sound settings: The music editor has been removed. Instead, a general volume feature has been introduced, allowing to control the sound level in the game.

 New levels added: This expands opportunities for exploration and skill testing.

 Joystick control improved: The joystick control mechanics have been updated and improved for greater intuitiveness and convenience.

 Errors fixed in locations: Errors in locations with infinite jumps have been eliminated. Now all jumps and movements work as intended.

 Overall difficulty of levels reduced: Listening to player feedback, the decision was made to reduce the overall difficulty of the levels. This should make the game more accessible and enjoyable.

 We hope these changes will be appreciated. Thank you for playing and your support!
